successCriteria.description: The LeaveType enum exposes exactly six members — annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity — each with a lowercase string value matching the leave_types.code controlled vocabulary.
The LeaveStatus enum exposes exactly five members — DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED — each with an uppercase string value matching the leave_requests.status column.

The AuditAction enum exposes exactly seven members — CREATED, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, BALANCE_DEDUCTED, BALANCE_RESTORED — each with an uppercase string value matching the audit_logs.action column.

LeaveRequestDTO and LeaveBalanceDTO are exported as TypeScript interfaces that compile cleanly under strict mode with no use of the any type; LeaveRequestDTO.status is typed as LeaveStatus and LeaveBalanceDTO.status is the string-literal union 'ACTIVE' | 'EXHAUSTED' | 'FROZEN'.
The barrel index.ts re-exports every enum and DTO symbol so that downstream modules can import all shared types from the single public entry point src/shared/types/index.ts.

A Jest unit test located under the tests/ directory with the .test.ts extension asserts the exact member counts and casing of all three enums, and is discovered and executed by the configured test runner (testMatch **/tests/**/*.test.(ts|js)).
The phase introduces no external runtime dependencies and the source compiles without errors via tsc --noEmit under the project's strict tsconfig (rootDir ./src, tests excluded from build).

constraints: No use of the any type anywhere in the shared-types module — use unknown with type guards or concrete types instead (HARNESS.json no-any, severity high).
The shared-types module must stand alone with no external runtime dependencies; only relative type/enum re-exports within src/shared/types/ are permitted.
All test files must use the .test.ts extension and live under the tests/ directory to match the Jest testMatch pattern **/tests/**/*.test.(ts|js); do not use .spec.ts naming or alter the Jest config.
TypeScript strict mode must pass (no implicit any, strict null checks); source under src/ must compile via tsc --noEmit with rootDir ./src and tests excluded from the build.
Modules import from each other only through their declared public entry point (index.ts); the shared-types barrel is the sole public surface for enums and DTOs.
outOfScope: The LeaveType entity interface (id, code, label, description, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt) — owned by the leave-policy module in a later phase, not by shared-types which only owns the LeaveType enum.

The LeaveBalance entity interface and LeaveRequest entity interface with Date-typed fields — these are domain entities owned by their respective modules in later phases; shared-types only owns the DTOs with string-typed date fields.
Audit module (AuditRecord entity, IAuditRepository, IAuditService) — deferred to a later phase; this phase only provides the AuditAction enum that the audit module will consume.
Any repository, service, controller, or route implementation — this phase is purely type/enum definitions with no runtime logic or database access.
DTO validation logic (e.g., class-validator decorators, zod schemas) — the DTOs are plain transport interfaces; validation at API boundaries is a later-phase concern per GP-003.

entityInvariants.invariant: The set of members is a fixed controlled vocabulary of exactly six leave categories (annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity); each member's string value equals its lowercase key, matching the leave_types.code column. No additional members may be added without an architecture decision.

The enum defines the complete LeaveRequest lifecycle states — DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED — where APPROVED, REJECTED, and CANCELLED are terminal; the set is closed and every member's value is uppercase matching the leave_requests.status column.

The enum enumerates every state-changing and balance-mutating action that must produce an audit record per GP-002 — CREATED, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, BALANCE_DEDUCTED, BALANCE_RESTORED; the set is closed so no auditable operation lacks a corresponding action value.

The DTO is a serializable transport shape for a LeaveRequest; its status field is constrained to the LeaveStatus enum and its nullable lifecycle fields (approvedBy, approvedAt, cancelledAt) are typed as string | null to represent absent values over the wire rather than undefined.

The DTO is a serializable transport shape for a LeaveBalance; its status field is the closed string-literal union 'ACTIVE' | 'EXHAUSTED' | 'FROZEN' matching the LeaveBalance lifecycle, and remainingDays is carried as a derived transport field even though the entity computes it as totalEntitlement - usedDays at query time.

interfaceConstraints.operation: Barrel re-export of all shared-types symbols from src/shared/types/index.ts — downstream modules import LeaveType, LeaveStatus, AuditAction, LeaveRequestDTO, and LeaveBalanceDTO exclusively through this public entry point.
interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — pure type/enum module with no runtime operations or authentication surface.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Compile-time only: a missing or misnamed export produces a TypeScript compile error, not a runtime error. The barrel must export every symbol so that downstream imports never fail to resolve.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The LeaveType enum member values must exactly match the controlled vocabulary documented for the LeaveType entity codes (annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity) so that DTOs and future leave_types seed data align.

The LeaveStatus enum member values must exactly match the LeaveRequest lifecycle states documented in the architecture (DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED) so that the leave-request module's status transitions reference the same closed set.

The AuditAction enum must cover every action that GP-002 requires an audit record for — including the balance-mutating actions BALANCE_DEDUCTED and BALANCE_RESTORED — so that the audit module's AuditRecord.action field uses a value from this enum.

The LeaveBalanceDTO.status string-literal union ('ACTIVE' | 'EXHAUSTED' | 'FROZEN') must exactly match the LeaveBalance entity lifecycle status documented in the reconciled architecture, ensuring the DTO transport shape and the domain entity stay aligned.

The barrel index.ts must re-export only the symbols declared in enums.ts and dtos.ts — no additional types, no re-exports from outside the shared-types directory — so the module boundary declared in the architecture (shared-types owns enums and DTOs) is respected.

integrationPoints.why: Will import LeaveStatus and LeaveRequestDTO from the shared-types barrel to type the LeaveRequest entity status field and the notification/transport surface.
Will import LeaveBalanceDTO and the LeaveType enum from the shared-types barrel to type balance transport shapes and scope balances per leave type.
Will import the AuditAction enum from the shared-types barrel to type the AuditRecord.action field, ensuring every auditable operation maps to a value from this closed set per GP-002.
All depend on shared-types per the reconciled dependency map; they import enums and DTOs through the barrel as their sole shared-type surface.
